name: Yukon Fish and Wildlife Enhancement Trust project funding

funder.name: Yukon Fish and Wildlife Enhancement Trust

summary: Annual call for proposals funding projects that restore, protect or enhance fish and wildlife populations and their habitat in Yukon. Requests up to CAD 15,000 are encouraged.

amount.note: Requests up to $15,000 are encouraged; any amount may be considered

status.quote: DEADLINE Proposals must be submitted electronically by 4:00 p.m. March 2, 2026.

deadline.quote: DEADLINE Proposals must be submitted electronically by 4:00 p.m. March 2, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: The Trust is always encouraging proposals for new projects from communities, community groups, renewable resource councils, non-profit groups, businesses, and individuals.

geography.quote: restore fish and wildlife populations or their habitat in the Yukon; protect fish and wildlife populations or their habitat in the Yukon; and enhance fish and wildlife populations or their habitat in the Yukon.

access.quote: A call for proposals occurs once each year between January 1st and March 1st.

window.quote: A call for proposals occurs once each year between January 1st and March 1st.

amount.quote: Requests up to a maximum of $15,000 are encouraged, however, any amount may be considered.

co_finance_required.quote: The Trust may fund up to 100% of any project. Funding from other sources is encouraged.
